summary: Five stories held for pictures, FII and Kasimedu fixes, homepage refreshed

editor_fail.why: Main picture is a calm, generic harbour scene ('fishing boats moored at a harbour in Chennai under a grey sky'), not Kasimedu as the hero asked for, and it shows neither the deaths and search at sea nor Chief Minister Vijay, who acted in the headline. A calm harbour is a stand-in under rules 1-3. The text also has two errors in both languages. (1) It says 'went missing at sea last week' / 'पिछले हफ्ते', but contact was lost on Tuesday, November 3, which is this week. (2) It says 'Five deaths were being reported by evening' / 'शाम तक पांच मौतों की खबर' with no source, which sits badly next to the three identified bodies everywhere else. (Text fixed in EN and HI: "on November 3", unsourced five-deaths sentence cut. Picture not fixable this run.)
editor_fail.fix: Replace the main picture with a sombre (not smiling) photo of CM Vijay, or a real photo of Kasimedu fishermen or families, the Coast Guard search or the Kothapatnam coast. Label it as a file photo if it is one. In EN and HI, change 'last week' to 'this week' (or 'on November 3'). Either attribute the five deaths without naming an outlet (for example 'some reports put the toll at five') or cut the sentence.

fixed_by_run.why: The standfirst says foreign institutions bought on 'their fourth straight buying day' (HI: 'लगातार चौथे दिन खरीदारी'). The story's own verification note says NiftyTrader shows a five-session FII buying streak that includes October 30, so 'fourth straight' is wrong. The DII key point 'their fourth selling day in a row' (HI: 'लगातार चौथे दिन') claims a run of days, but the October 30 DII figure was never seen.
fixed_by_run.done: Standfirst now says fourth buying day this month; DII key point now says selling in all four November sessions (EN and HI).
